use.flag: Enable journald logging via sys-apps/systemd's libsystemd

pkgmetadata.longdescription: Lemonade is a local AI server from AMD that runs LLMs, speech, and image-generation models on personal GPUs and NPUs through an OpenAI-compatible API, with pluggable backends such as llama.cpp, whisper.cpp, stable-diffusion.cpp, FastFlowLM, and RyzenAI. This package provides the `lemond` server daemon and the `lemonade` CLI client; the bundled web UI and desktop app are not built.
